newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez Lyonnaise merger will boost value - Monod.
newsitem.headline: Suez Lyonnaise merger will boost value - Monod.

text.p: The proposed merger of cash-rich holding Cie de Suez and utilities company Lyonnaise des Eaux will boost shareholder value, Lyonnaise chairman Jerome Monod said in a television interview on Tuesday.

"The best way to create shareholder value is to be big enough, to have the critical mass for the big cities across the world in what we want to develop," Monod told CNN television in a joint interview with Suez chief executive Gerard Mestrallet.
Asked about the logic behind the deal, Mestrallet said, "It is not a synergy-driven merger. It is a growth driven merger."
But he said the new company would be cautious in its expansion plans and reiterated its ambitious profit goals.

"We are driven not only by size but also by profitability. To create value for our shareholders, we have in mind to double profitability in five years. Therefore we shall be very cautious in using our financial means," he said.
The companies formally announced plans to merge last Friday.
